Got it. If you liked the buddy cop absurdity of 21 Jump Street, try:

The Other Guys, Will Ferrell and Mark Wahlberg as mismatched cops, very funny.

Let's Be Cops, two guys buy cop uniforms and things escalate fast.

Ride Along, Ice Cube and Kevin Hart, dumb but charming.

Central Intelligence, The Rock and Kevin Hart, more action comedy.

Bad Boys for Life, less goofy, but still buddy cop energy.

Rush Hour is a perfect pick. Chan and Tucker have exactly that bickering buddy energy you like. Start with the first one, the chemistry is gold.

If you want more after that, the Night at the Museum movies with Ben Stiller hit the same goofy action note.
Actually rush hour 1 made in 1998 so late

Fair point. If you want newer buddy cop chaos, try:

The Lost City, Channing Tatum and Sandra Bullock, funny and easy.

The Hit Man, Glen Powell, more comedy than action but very sharp.

Free Guy, goofy action comedy with heart.

The Nice Guys, if you haven't seen it, that's the closest to 21 Jump Street energy.
